output.reason: At 32 weeks pregnant with persistent headache, blurred vision and facial/hand swelling, severe preeclampsia is sufficiently plausible to require immediate emergency obstetric assessment with blood pressure and urine testing today.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department or your maternity unit now. Persistent headache with blurry vision and facial/hand puffiness at 32 weeks can mean preeclampsia, which needs blood pressure, urine and blood testing right away. Have someone drive you rather than driving yourself. Call 911 immediately if you have a seizure, severe belly pain, trouble breathing, or you faint.
differential: Preeclampsia with severe features at 32 weeks
Other pregnancy-related headache cause (e.g. PRES, cerebral venous thrombosis)

redFlags.concern: Upper abdominal pain, seizure, reduced fetal movement

output.vitalSigns: No blood pressure or other readings reported; whether any measurement was taken is unknown.
output.evidenceLimitations: Consumer pregnancy summary lists symptoms but gives no individual urgency threshold, and no blood pressure or urine findings are reported here.
